name: build
vm_prebuild_cloudinit_extra_cmds: DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y docker.io docker-buildx git zstd

su - ubuntu -c 'v=@RUNNER_VERSION@; a=$(dpkg --print-architecture | sed s/amd64/x64/); mkdir -p actions-runner-$v && curl -fsSL https://github.com/actions/runner/releases/download/v$v/actions-runner-linux-$a-$v.tar.gz | tar -xz -C actions-runner-$v'
DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get purge -y --auto-remove snapd modemmanager udisks2 multipath-tools open-iscsi unattended-upgrades
systemctl mask apt-daily.timer apt-daily-upgrade.timer motd-news.timer update-notifier-download.timer fwupd-refresh.timer
